pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā channo anācāraṃ ācarati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.7: kiṃ nu kho nāma tumhe āvuso maṃ vattabbaṃ maññatha
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.11: seyyathāpi nāma mahāvāto vāyanto tiṇakaṭṭhapaṇṇasaṭaṃ ekato ussādeyya seyyathāpi vā pana nadī pabbateyyā saṅkhasevālapaṇakaṃ ekato ussādeyya
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.12: evameva tumhe nānānāmā nānāgottā nānājaccā nānākulā pabbajitā ekato ussāditā
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.13: kiṃ nu kho nāma tumhe āvuso maṃ vattabbaṃ maññatha
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.17: ye te bhikkhū appicchā santuṭṭhā lajjino kukkuccakā sikkhākāmā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.18: kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā channo bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ karissatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.19: athakho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ. athakho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātāpetvā āyasmantaṃ channaṃ paṭipucchi
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.20: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ channa bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ karosīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.23: akaraṇīyaṃ kathaṃ hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ karissasi
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.25: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.26.1: bhikkhu paneva dubbacajātiko hoti uddesapariyāpannesu sikkhāpadesu bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ karotiḍa
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.27: mā maṃ āyasmanto kiñci avacuttha kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā ahampāyasmante na kiñci vakkhāmi kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.30: mā āyasmā attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ akāsi vacanīyameva āyasmā attānaṃ karotu
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.31: āyasmāpi bhikkhū vadetu sahadhammena bhikkhūpi āyasmantaṃ vakkhanti sahadhammena
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.32: evaṃ saṃvaḍḍhā hi tassa bhagavato parisā yadidaṃ aññamaññavacanena aññamaññavuṭṭhāpanenāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.33: evañca so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno tatheva paggaṇheyya so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbo tassa paṭinissaggāya
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.34: yāvatatiyañce samanubhāsiyamāno taṃ paṭinissajjeyya iccetaṃ kusalaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:2.2: dubbaco hoti dovacassakaraṇehi dhammehi samannāgato akkhamo appadakkhiṇaggāhī anusāsaniṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:2.8: yaṃ bhagavatā paññattaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ etaṃ sahadhammikaṃ nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:2.10: mā maṃ āyasmanto kiñci avacuttha kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā ahampāyasmante na kiñci vakkhāmi kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā viramathāyasmanto mama vacanāyāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:2.14: aññehi bhikkhūhi. ye passanti ye suṇanti tehi vattabbo

pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:2.25: mā āyasmā attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ akāsi vacanīyameva āyasmā attānaṃ karotu āyasmāpi bhikkhū vadetu sahadhammena bhikkhūpi āyasmantaṃ vakkhanti sahadhammena evaṃ saṃvaḍḍhā hi tassa bhagavato parisā yadidaṃ aññamaññavacanena
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:2.35: ayaṃ itthannāmo bhikkhu bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ karoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:2.37: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ saṅgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ samanubhāseyya tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya.
